execution_stages.name: training_launch
execution_stages.description: The shell launcher calls train.py with concrete runtime overrides for data, smoothing, sharing, batch size, warmup, epochs, seed, output directory, and tensorboard.

execution_stages.name: training_setup
execution_stages.description: train.py parses arguments, sets reproducibility options, loads data, builds the Transformer, wraps Adam with ScheduledOptim, and starts training.

execution_stages.name: epoch_update
execution_stages.description: Each training epoch prepares tensors, forwards the model, computes loss/performance, backpropagates, and updates scheduled learning rate.

execution_stages.name: preprocess_data
execution_stages.description: preprocess.py downloads/merges corpora, learns BPE, encodes files, filters by length, builds vocabulary, and serializes processed data.

method_stages.name: input_preparation
method_stages.purpose: Prepare tokenized and serialized translation data for training.

method_stages.name: transformer_computation
method_stages.purpose: Apply encoder/decoder Transformer layers built from attention and position-wise feed-forward sublayers.

method_stages.name: scheduled_optimization
method_stages.purpose: Optimize the Transformer with label smoothing and warmup learning-rate scheduling.
